# Lab 13.12: Cost, Quotas & Optimised Mode

## What We Are Going to Do
Estimate tokens before running, find the Vertex AI cost of a job, cap failures with `max_error_ratio`, and use optimised mode for large AI.IF jobs.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Estimate tokens first.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT SUM(AI.COUNT_TOKENS(review)) AS input_tokens
FROM lab13.reviews;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Multiply by the model's price per million input tokens to estimate the cost.

2. **[Console] Read token counts on a job.** Run any AI.GENERATE query. In **Job information**, find the generative AI section: input tokens, output tokens and cached tokens.

3. **[Console] Find the Vertex AI cost.** **Billing → Reports**, filter **Service: Vertex AI**, and add the label filter `bigquery_job_id_prefix` = your job ID.

4. **[SQL] Fail fast on errors.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title FROM lab13.reviews
WHERE AI.IF(('This review mentions music: ', review), max_error_ratio =&gt; 0.1);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   If more than 10% of rows fail (for example, because of quota), the query fails instead of returning partial results.

5. **[SQL] Optimised mode for big tables.** For roughly 3,000+ rows, AI.IF can learn from embeddings and call the LLM for fewer rows:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext`
WHERE AI.IF(
  ('The following news story is about a natural disaster: ', body),
  embeddings =&gt; AI.EMBED(body, endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005', task_type =&gt; 'CLASSIFICATION').result,
  optimization_mode =&gt; 'MINIMIZE_COST'
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   In real use, store the embeddings in a column (Module 14) so they are not recomputed.

6. **[CLI] Check AI quota.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services quota list --service=aiplatform.googleapis.com --consumer=projects/$PROJECT_ID --filter="metric~generate" 2&gt;/dev/null | head -20</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Estimate | `AI.COUNT_TOKENS` before running |
| Actual | Token counts in job information |
| Billing | Vertex AI charges labelled by job ID |
| Scale | Optimised mode calls the LLM for fewer rows |
